question: Marianne's avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
Marianne's (Marianne's Harvest) avocado oil brand is owned and operated by the
Adams Group
, a fifth-generation, family-owned Northern California agriculture and ingredients company with roots dating back to 1920.
